>
[Antler Rush](/Feats.aspx?ID=5490) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 76

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); weremoose

**Requirements**
You’re in your moose or hybrid shape.

</column>

---

Stride twice. If you end your movement within your antlers' reach of an enemy, you can [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=2383), [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380), or Strike with your antlers.
